lines.text: The LORD tells Judah to hear, because the people have eyes that do not see and ears that do not hear.
The LORD set the Jordan River as the boundary for the sea, and the waves cannot cross it.
The people have stubborn and rebellious hearts, and they never say they should fear the LORD who gives the rains.
Wicked men set a trap to catch lambs, and their deceit made them rich, but they ignored the fatherless.
The prophets prophesy falsely, the priests rule by their own authority, and the people love it so.
